scope: ADDITIONAL_READ_ONLY_QUOTE_EVIDENCE; original campaign and final selection remain sealed

requirements.requirement: Find an official historical broker tick source; distinguish observed availability from documentation.
Read-only market quotes from existing MT5 connection; no login, new account, orders, fills, or personal account export.
All eight application safety flags false; automatic trading disabled at terminal and program levels.
Preserve exact requested and received times, source/server/account class, all ticks including same-millisecond rows and bid/ask.
Verify ordering, valid sides, ranges, gaps and partial/synchronization errors; never infer full broker retention from count.
Raw source, source-code hash, artifact hashes and independent recomputation of quote statistics.
Bounded prospective public quote capture separate from broker-specific quotes, with exclusive lock and safe resume.
Run meaningful tests and actual available data capture; mark unavailable platform paths NOT TESTED.
Keep historical cost schedule, execution and profitability gates unverified unless evidence actually supplies them.
Do not restart closed campaign/replay, tune sealed final or revive paused heartbeat.

assumptions_not_verified: MT5 server retains requested older periods
Tick times are confirmed UTC equivalent for this broker
smallest_falsification: A 60-second Boom500 and Crash500 history request in an older and recent UTC-labelled window; empty/error/partial/out-of-range response must remain explicit.
